programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: During the last days of World War II, a solitary prospector crosses paths with Nazis on a scorched-Earth retreat in northern Finland. When the soldiers decide to steal his gold, they quickly discover they just tangled with no ordinary miner.

programme.title: Boy Kills World

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: Though he once spent time in San Quentin, 22-year-old black man Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) is now trying hard to live a clean life and support his girlfriend (Melonie Diaz) and young daughter (Ariana Neal). Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
programme.desc: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

programme.desc: Clyde Shelton is an honorable family man, until the day his wife and daughter are murdered in a home invasion. He hopes for justice, but a rising prosecutor named Nick Rice cuts a deal with one of the killers in exchange for testimony. Ten years later, that man is found dead.

programme.title: Man on a Ledge
programme.desc: When disgraced ex-cop Nick Cassidy (Sam Worthington) steps onto the ledge of the highest floor of New York's famous Roosevelt Hotel, more than just his life is at risk; he threatens to bring the city to its knees. There are some very nervous people around with some very big secrets to hide. As police negotiator Lydia Spencer (Elizabeth Banks) tries to talk Nick in from the ledge, she begins to suspect that he has an ulterior motive behind his actions.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: The Next Three Days
programme.desc: Life for John and Lara Brennan (Russell Crowe, Elizabeth Banks) is miserable after she is convicted of a murder she says she did not commit. Three years later while struggling with the demands of work and raising his son alone, John is still trying to establish her innocence. When her final appeal is rejected, Lara becomes suicidal, forcing John to exercise the only option he has left: Break her out of prison.

programme.title: A Most Wanted Man
programme.desc: An escaped militant's (Grigoriy Dobrygin) attempt to claim an inheritance gives a German agent (Philip Seymour Hoffman) the chance to lay a trap for a well-regarded Muslim scholar who is suspected of financing terrorists.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: Pilot Brodie Torrance saves passengers from a lightning strike by making a risky landing on a war-torn island -- only to find that surviving the landing was just the beginning. When dangerous rebels take most of the passengers hostage, the only person Torrance can count on for help is Louis Gaspare, an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

As life on the ship descends into chaos, they soon become consumed by fear, lust and an insatiable hunger for power.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Young entrepreneurs Sean (Emile Hirsch) and Ben (Max Minghella) meet stranded travelers Natalie (Olivia Thirlby) and Anne (Rachael Taylor) at a hot Moscow nightclub. Their whole world changes in an instant when an alien attack devastates the city and everything goes dark. Joined by a Swedish businessman (Joel Kinnaman), the youths emerge from hiding days later and must somehow fight back against a nearly invisible enemy that could find and disintegrate them at any moment.

programme.title: Knowing
programme.desc: Fifty years after it was buried in a time capsule, a schoolgirl's cryptic document falls into the hands of Caleb Koestler, the son of professor John Koestler (Nicolas Cage). John figures out that the encoded message accurately lists every major disaster from the past five decades, and predicts three future calamities -- one a global cataclysm. When his warnings fall on deaf ears, John enlists the help of the prophetic author's daughter and granddaughter to try to avert the ultimate disaster.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas (Brenton Thwaites) lives in a seemingly idyllic world of conformity and contentment. When he begins to spend time with The Giver (Jeff Bridges), an old man who is the sole keeper of the community's memories, Jonas discovers the dangerous truths of his community's secret past. Armed with the power of knowledge, Jonas realizes that he must escape from their world to protect himself and those he loves -- a challenge no one has ever completed successfully.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: After his father, an assassin, is brutally murdered, Nick Gant vows revenge on Division, the covert government agency that dabbles in psychic warfare and experimental drugs. Hiding in Hong Kong's underworld, Nick assembles a band of rogue psychics dedicated to destroying Division. Together with Cassie, a teenage clairvoyant, Nick goes in search of a missing girl and a stolen suitcase that could be the key to accomplishing their mutual goal.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: This film documents the buildup to the Vietnam War, from the withdrawal of French troops to the bombings of the U.S. Embassy and the intense fighting our troops engaged in to combat Ho Chi Minh and the Viet Cong. The footage features President Lyndon Johnson, Secretary of State Dean Rusk and Secretary of Defense Robert McNamara.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: It fell to the Russians to enter Berlin first, and as Hitler took his own life in his bunker, the war in Europe finally came to an end. Winston Churchill led the people of Britain in the VE Day celebrations, but the fighting continued in the Pacific.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With Europe sifting through the rubble of a long and bitter war, the Japanese refused to surrender. A long land campaign was too high a price to pay. Truman took the decision to end WWII swiftly, with the nuclear bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France by the 7th army and subsequent junction with the American 3rd army in northwest part of France.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: British artillery pounds German positions in northern France and troops advance through villages and care for civilians. Tanks clear mine fields. Part 2, American troops enter Cherbourg. The 6th Airborne Div. receives supplies by parachute from British planes. Gen. J.L. Collins accepts the surrender of German officers.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The Greatest coordination of arms ever portrayed in the world. Every scene made during the greatest victory of Allied power, to date. 11,000 Allied planes plant their tons of pulverizing bombs on shore installations, strategic roads and bridges, then swoop down to strafe enemy trains, ships and planes. The air poundings continue, and the mop-up search for snipers is on. The invasion is successful.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: In this episode, the complex web of alliances and partnerships forms as the conflict expands. The entry of the Soviet Union and the United States into the war drastically shifts the balance of power. We also explore the significance of Japan's imperial ambitions, culminating in the attack on Pearl Harbor, which brought the U.S. fully into the conflict.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and Wagner
programme.desc: From the moment in 1906 when he heard the first note of Lohengrin at Linz opera house until his death in the burning ruins of Berlin in 1945, Hitler was obsessed by the music and mythology of Richard Wagner. The latest research into the often overlooked relationship with musician August Kubizek, his only boyhood friend, has provided clues which have reveal the overwhelming importance of Wagner.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: Dieppe 1942, the mention of this name and date is enough to recall the sinister memory of an allied raid composed essentially of Canadian troops. On August 19, after 9 hours of fighting, 1,197 Allied soldiers, including 913 Canadians, were killed. 48 French civilians also died... At the height of the fighting, the attackers lost four men per second. The Dieppe raid turned into a massacre!

programme.title: Sacrifice: From D-Day to the Liberation of Paris
programme.desc: June 5th, 1944: A monumental Allied force assembles to liberate Europe from Nazi rule. With tension high and WWII entering its fifth year, two million soldiers stand prepared for sacrifice. In France, civilians eagerly await their deliverance, listening to Radio-London. As Allies land in Normandy, civilians, oblivious to danger, emerge to welcome them amidst combat.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: In April 1945, just weeks before the war's end, Allied troops advancing on the Western Front uncovered and liberated numerous POW, labor, and concentration camps. It was only when the Americans opened camps like Ohrdruf, Buchenwald, and Dachau in Germany that the world truly grasped the scale of the horrors inflicted by the Nazis, revealing atrocities that had remained hidden until then.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Threatened by numerous attacks by enemy troops in the Cam Lo area, 8,500 Marines and 3,000 ARVN troops strike along the Demilitarized Zone on July 7, 1966. The battle, Operation Hastings, lasted until August 3rd. The Marines pushed the NVA forces back across the DMZ.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: In this episode, viewers see how the U.S. Navy's submarines contributed to the Japanese empire's defeat, sinking thousands of tons of commercial ships.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: The United Nations planned how best to secure victory and how to arrange the post war world at conference after conference. The Allies fought one war on two fronts. The Axis fought two wars. For both, 1943 would mark the beginning of the end.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The strategic Marine Corps base at Khe Sanh was located a few miles from the borders of North Vietnam and Laos. Khe Sanh was heavily fortified in late '67 and designed to carry out reconnaissance attacks on the Ho Chi Minh trail and enemy supply lines from the north.

programme.title: Hitler and Churchill: The Eagle and the Lion
programme.desc: From 1940 to 1945, these two vastly contradictory personalities thought of nothing else but how to destroy each other. For the first time, a film tells the story of this clash of the giants from their common experience in the trenches of the First World War until the end of World War II.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Replays the drama and battle action of the period of the landing at Normandy and the fierce combat to overcome the wall of 'Fortress Europe' in June 1944.

programme.title: Leibstandarte: Hitler's Elite Bodyguard
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler raised a group of 200 men, fanatics known as the 'Stosstrupp-Hitler'. They were brought together by Nazi thug who was also a trusted friend of Hitler's named Sepp Deitrich. He and the men of the bodyguard pledged themselves to defending the life of the man who's name they wore on their sleeves so proudly.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: Master of Propaganda. The fanatic who shaped the first modern political spin machine and the man who harnessed the combined power of radio, print, posters, film and oratory to shape the political agenda.

programme.title: Mother of Normandy
programme.desc: Leslie Caron narrates 'Mother of Normandy,' a documentary highlighting Simone Renaud, wife of the wartime Mayor of Ste. Mere-Eglise. For 44 years, she expressed gratitude to D-Day veterans and families by tending graves, corresponding, and organizing commemorations. Renaud became a cherished figure, leaving an enduring impact on those touched by D-Day's legacy.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: The basic combat formation of the modern land army is the division. Divisions contain all of the elements needed to wage land combat including infantry, armor, artillery and other supporting arms. Divisions are substantial in size from 10,000 to 20,000 troops, nearly 500 armored vehicles and 2000 other vehicles.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Six months have passed with very little action in the Phony War. That is about to end and a new word is added to the vocabulary of warfare - Blitzkrieg.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Zhenya asks Marina Raskova to intercede for Galya. Raskova orders Galya freed from tribunal and reinstated as Zhenya's navigator. Makeev's team must steal secret documents from a courier protected by twenty truck-mounted submachine gunners. Brave pilots will bomb targets to distract the guards.

programme.title: After Hitler
programme.desc: After all the joy of the 8th of May 1945, Europe is still in the grip of violence. The Allies are faced with enormous challenges...More than forty million people have been displaced during the conflict and now they all want to go home. Germany is now occupied, and divided into four zones. And people are still hungry. How can a whole devastated continent be rebuilt?

programme.title: German Fighters
programme.desc: Hitler acknowledged the existence as the new German air force known as the Luftwaffe on the first of March 1935. The front line fighters of the Luftwaffe during WWII were the Bf-109 and the FW-190. Interviews with pilots who flew these planes and officers who sent them into battle. The film covers German Fighter development and Luftwaffe strategy from the 1930's to the end of World War II.

programme.title: Night Bombers
programme.desc: Rare archive colour footage of an RAF bombing raid on Berlin in the winter of 1943 - probably the most heavily defended target of them all. 440 Avro Lancaster heavy bombers and 4 de Havilland Mosquitos led the attack causing extensive damage to Berlin.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won & Lost
programme.desc: Every war sees new tactics, some inspired, some desperate that try to influence the course of battles: Guadalcanal, Allied Bombing, Dakar, Leningrad, Leyte Gulf, Crete.

programme.title: Visions of War: The Korean War
programme.desc: Depicts the important role of artillery fire in modern warfare.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: James H. Doolittle is discussed, along with other Air Force Commanders.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and Wagner
programme.desc: From the moment in 1906 when he heard the first note of Lohengrin at Linz opera house until his death in the burning ruins of Berlin in 1945, Hitler was obsessed by the music and mythology of Richard Wagner. The latest research into the often overlooked relationship with musician August Kubizek, his only boyhood friend, has provided clues which have reveal the overwhelming importance of Wagner.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: From the moment Adolf Hitler marched his troops into Poland on the 1st of September 1939, the Second World War was inevitable. As the opening skirmishes are played out, see for yourself the events that shaped the escalating crisis.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As the New Year dawned and the people of Britain faced the introduction of rationing, all eyes turned northwards to Scandinavia. U-Boat attacks increased and at Scapa Flow a German Air Raid claimed the first British casualties.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The aerial and amphibious assault on the beaches of Normandy and the allied convoys landing on the Normandy beaches. Shows Gens. Eisenhower and Montgomery and Adm. Sir Bertram Ramsey.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The Greatest coordination of arms ever portrayed in the world. Every scene made during the greatest victory of Allied power, to date. 11,000 Allied planes plant their tons of pulverizing bombs on shore installations, strategic roads and bridges, then swoop down to strafe enemy trains, ships and planes. The air poundings continue, and the mop-up search for snipers is on. The invasion is successful.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: To Adolf Hitler in 1940, Britain was no more than an irritant on his periphery to his rapidly expanding Third Reich. He was correct in his assumption that Britain had been almost fatally weakened by the fight of Dunkirk. If Britain were to be subdued, there seemed to be no more auspicious time than 1940. The Luftwaffe had proven themselves invincible, which filled them with pride and enthusiasm.

programme.title: The War In Burma
programme.desc: This military film documents the War in Burma in the South-East Asian theater of World War II.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On September 1, 1939, Germany invaded Poland in a blitzkrieg fueled not only by tactics and technology, but also by Pervitin-crystal meth. Developed in 1938, this 'miracle pill' boosted soldiers' endurance and morale, becoming a weapon of war. Declassified files, including Hitler's medical records, uncover Project D-IX and reveal how meth shaped Nazi power and altered the course of history.

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service: The Story of Britain's Rich Spy History
programme.desc: Sir David searches out Britain's eccentric amateur inventors and backyard boffins, who played a key role in the defeat of Hitler and created the machinery of 21st-century surveillance.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: This program looks at the epic charge of the Light Brigade, when a misunderstood Order sent troops straight into the main Russian artillery during the Battle of Balaclava. It also looks at the later Battle of Inkerman and the work of Florence Nightingale.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Before 1941 was half over, the Soviet Union was locked in struggle with Germany. Before the year was out, humanity would be hanging on the fate of Roosevelt's great union, compelled to join the struggle by what he termed 'a date which will live in infamy.'

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Big Slim is an aviation legend. During a nail-biting engagement in the skies over Europe, Sgt Fred 'Big Slim' Richardson's tall frame was struck by thirty-six pieces of shrapnel. To any other man, such wounds would have been fatal, but Big Slim was different, toughing it out to lead his unit to victory. Such courage sees the Sergeant remembered even all these years later. Stars Jim Hutton.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: This is the story of the Army's Psychological Warfare activities in the Far East Command, primarily as a tactical weapon in Korea. We augment the effectiveness of our combat forces with the potent weapon of words. Through leaflets, shot by artillery shells or dropped from planes; through radio news and through loudspeakers mounted on tanks and jeeps, we send our messages of truth to the enemy.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: During this hour, witness the World shaking events that took place of the years immediately preceding WW2. You'll also see the Nazi subjugation of France and England's heroic defense in the Battle of Britain. Pearl Harbor is also discussed.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Reaching the heart of Hitler's Third Reich brought some of the war's bloodiest battles. As East Company, 253rd Regiment, 63rd Infantry advanced through Untergresheim to secure a vital bridge over the River Jagst, they realized they were without an officer. In their moment of need, Sgt. Webb and Private First-Class Brad Fisher took up the challenge and took command.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: The Blitz shook Britain, but the Allies struck back harder with strategic bombing. Technology advanced-radar, gun turrets, and bomb sights changed everything. Civil defenses rose. After Pearl Harbor, the US joined in, bringing more bombers, more power, and a new level of destruction to the war.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: During WWII, a squadron faces a treacherous airdrome mission. Bordeaux loses film, compromising the op. They celebrate a victory but face danger later. A pilot reveals fatigue and refuses duty. Charged as a coward, he returns home to a different life. War impacts loved ones, and exemptions stir emotions.

programme.title: The Reich Underground
programme.desc: Today, many of the half-built facilities have been long-forgotten. With previously unreleased film material and exclusive interviews, the fascinating and dramatic story of the Underground Reich is reconstructed when the Nazis leaders still hoped that the miracle weapons they produced would bring Germany final victory.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Fighter Aircraft - WWI
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry discusses the fighters of WWI, like the Nieuport 17, Albatross, Sopwith Camel, Fokker, and many more.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: By June 1940, Nazi Germany had occupied Paris. France was cut in two. North of the demarcation line was the German-occupied zone and to the south was a zone headed by Marshal Pétain, whose seat of government was in the central spa town of Vichy. The Vichy regime very quickly, and without pressure from the Germans, passed the first Jewish laws.

programme.title: The U-Boat War
programme.desc: Twenty years after the defeat of Kaiser Wilhem the II, the German navy, The Kriegsmarine, had once again grown into a powerful weapon, nurtured this time through Hitler's Third Reich. By 1939, Germany was eager and ready to wipe out the stain of her naval history and possessed a terrifying weapon that made sure Hitler's visions were realized - The U Boat.

programme.title: Sword of Honour
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 18 May 1939, the Nazis opened Ravensbrück, the largest women's concentration camp. Of the 130,000 women and children deported, 90,000 died. Through survivor testimonies, expert insights, 3D models, and reconstructions, this film reveals the camp's brutal conditions and the remarkable resilience of those who endured its horrors.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Wehrmacht Major Otto Link seeks revenge on Soviet pilots who foiled his mission and wiped out saboteurs. At HQ he unveils a night-vision device in his Messerschmitt, letting it fly unseen in darkness. The Germans, aware of an imminent Soviet infantry assault on the bridgehead, prepare a deadly surprise for the bombers-an invisible Messer.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: The downed 'Messer' crashes in a forest but doesn't explode. Both Germans and Soviet scouts race to recover its night-vision device. Its creator, German scientist Holts, also seeks it, tracking Soviet moves and anticipating the Swallows' aerial reconnaissance. The wreck lies in a swamp, making recovery far more difficult.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: When Winston Churchill becomes Prime Minister of the wartime coalition government in May 1940, he pledges his blood, toil, tears and sweat; within days of his appointment, he is made to honor his promise; with France near defeat and Allied soldiers trapped at Dunkirk, Churchill faces a critical challenge; capturing the drama and resilience that defined his leadership during Britain's darkest hour.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With mainland Europe under Hitler's control, the German Fuhrer turned his attention to Operation Sealion, and the Battle of Britain. However he'd underestimated the enormity of the task and the spirit of a nation inspired by Winston Churchill.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Landing Craft - Establishing Beachead. Silent film.

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This second episode covers the last week of March to late April. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service: The Story of Britain's Rich Spy History
programme.desc: Sir David searches out Britain's eccentric amateur inventors and backyard boffins, who played a key role in the defeat of Hitler and created the machinery of 21st-century surveillance.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: Our patrols in probing actions... The attack on Hill 1179... The return of Seoul refugees... and more of the ceasefire negotiations. Two combat cameramen of the Army Signal Corps are interviewed, Corporal John Romanowski of Chicago, Illinois, and Sergeant Lee Marks of Providence, Rhode Island. They tell a dramatic story of filming our troops for the newsreels and for 'The Big Picture.'

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: This episode chronicles the Battle of The Bulge and how our forces struck back and defeated Hitler's last stand.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler
programme.desc: In 1944, Operation Valkyrie and Colonel Count Claus von Stauffenberg got within striking distance of assassination of the Führer. This program examines the attempted July Bomb Plot. Why Hitler lost World War II: Examines the enormous sacrifice the free world paid to defeat the Führer and his thirst for power.

programme.title: WWII: Capitulation
programme.desc: May 8, 1945. While the Allied troops were parading through liberated towns to cheering crowds, the Second World War was in its final, apocalyptic hours. The weeks preceding the end of the conflict would usher in a new world. The Soviets, more powerful than ever, invaded conquered territories and terrorized survivors. The last Nazi soldiers attempted to escape their inevitable fates.

programme.title: Wings of Destruction
programme.desc: From Pearl Harbor to the Japanese home islands this is the story of the air war in the Pacific. It includes the daring ambush of Yamamota, the remarkable story of Richard Bong and Pappy Boyington as well as the Japanese Kamikazes.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: In November 1943 at the Tehran Conference, Churchill agreed to an offensive that would once again bring his British forces to full scale combat with the Nazis. Allied Supreme Commander Dwight D. Eisenhower arrived in London in January 1944 for final planning. The obvious route to France was heavily defended and lacked a major port. The only feasible alternative were the beaches of Normandy.

programme.title: Visions of War: The Korean War
programme.desc: The Army on horseback that once was the United States Cavalry is no more, for our Army today is a mechanized force. But 'cavalry' is a proud word in military terminology and no one displays that pride more than the men of the 1st Cavalry Division. Today, these men of the division keep alive the cavalry's legendary tradition of bravery by fighting, when they are called upon.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: Six months after annexing Austria, Hitler sets his sights on Sudetenland in Czechoslovakia, home to millions of ethnic Germans. He threatens force to get it. British PM Neville Chamberlain negotiates with Hitler, making three trips to Germany in two weeks to avoid war. But how much did he consult with Czechoslovakia or France? And how did he fare against a determined and volatile Hitler?

programme.title: The War In Burma
programme.desc: This military film documents the War in Burma in the South-East Asian theater of World War II.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: During WWII, a squadron faces a treacherous airdrome mission. Bordeaux loses film, compromising the op. They celebrate a victory but face danger later. A pilot reveals fatigue and refuses duty. Charged as a coward, he returns home to a different life. War impacts loved ones, and exemptions stir emotions.

programme.title: Sword of Honour
programme.desc: The story is one man's heroic quest to fight for a deep moral cause and to reclaim his manhood after a shattering divorce from society beauty Virginia Troy.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Wehrmacht Major Otto Link seeks revenge on Soviet pilots who foiled his mission and wiped out saboteurs. At HQ he unveils a night-vision device in his Messerschmitt, letting it fly unseen in darkness. The Germans, aware of an imminent Soviet infantry assault on the bridgehead, prepare a deadly surprise for the bombers-an invisible Messer.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: To Adolf Hitler in 1940, Britain was no more than an irritant on his periphery to his rapidly expanding Third Reich. He was correct in his assumption that Britain had been almost fatally weakened by the fight of Dunkirk. If Britain were to be subdued, there seemed to be no more auspicious time than 1940. The Luftwaffe had proven themselves invincible, which filled them with pride and enthusiasm.

programme.title: Afghanistan 1979-1989
programme.desc: By analyzing different perspectives and narratives, this research aims to contribute to a better understanding of this significant chapter in Soviet and Afghan history. It seeks to shed light on the multifaceted causes that led to the conflict and rectify its 'forgotten' status, ensuring its rightful place in the historical record.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this fifth film of the series, '1943', watch the cracks start to appear in Hitler's plans for world domination. Beginning with the total destruction of the German 6th Army by the Russians, and defeat at the Battle of Stalingrad, the Nazis then let North Africa slip away form them at the Battle of El Alamein.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: Germany's retreat continues as the Allies liberate France and Belgium. Montgomery's ambition to end the war risks more than his reputation as the push toward the Netherlands begins.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Faith conquers fear. Caught behind enemy lines with their Paratroop Battalion, Chaplain Francis Sampson and Medic Fred Banners tend to their wounded unit. But paralyzed by fear of the barrage of shells, Banners is more trouble than help. The Chaplain's faith comes into full force, insisting to remain with the wounded while his unit retreats. Witnessing true faith, the Medic Banners goes to work.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: The downed 'Messer' crashes in a forest but doesn't explode. Both Germans and Soviet scouts race to recover its night-vision device. Its creator, German scientist Holts, also seeks it, tracking Soviet moves and anticipating the Swallows' aerial reconnaissance. The wreck lies in a swamp, making recovery far more difficult.

programme.title: The U-Boat War
programme.desc: Twenty years after the defeat of Kaiser Wilhem the II, the German navy, The Kriegsmarine, had once again grown into a powerful weapon, nurtured this time through Hitler's Third Reich. By 1939, Germany was eager and ready to wipe out the stain of her naval history and possessed a terrifying weapon that made sure Hitler's visions were realized - The U Boat.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler
programme.desc: German produced documentary which chronicles the background, rise to power, rule, and downfall of Adolf Hitler. Includes glimpses of rare documents and extensive interviews with people who served under him. Volume 1 - The Face of Evil explores the path of hitler from insignificance, to World domination, and demonstrates the delusions he had that lead to massive deaths during the War.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Big Slim is an aviation legend. During a nail-biting engagement in the skies over Europe, Sgt Fred 'Big Slim' Richardson's tall frame was struck by thirty-six pieces of shrapnel. To any other man, such wounds would have been fatal, but Big Slim was different, toughing it out to lead his unit to victory. Such courage sees the Sergeant remembered even all these years later. Stars Jim Hutton.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Worldwide, the conflict continued to escalate as Japan made their presence felt as signatories of the Tripartite Pact, giving Hitler's Axis of Evil more power. Britain stood alone as the nightly bombing raids of the Blitz devastated major cities.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The Luftwaffe continued its attempts to bomb Britain into submission, while the German Afrika Korps strengthened its position as Rommel, Hitler's 'Desert Fox', took charge. At sea the naval forces battle each other and the elements.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Replays the drama and battle action of the period of the landing at Normandy and the fierce combat to overcome the wall of 'Fortress Europe' in June 1944.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: This German Field Marshall had tributes paid to him by both Winston Churchill and Adolf Hitler. He was revered by his own troops and respected by those who fought against him. A close adviser to The Fuhrer, and part of an attempt to kill him. Rommel's controversial legacy as both a hero, and a War Criminal is still debated today.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: Here is an exciting film documentary of the famous 'Indianheads,' the men of the U.S. 2nd Infantry Division in Korea. Although the fighting in Korea is over, the deeds of the 2nd Infantry Division will long be remembered. Out of the struggle in Korea have come many accounts of great suffering and even greater heroism, but few of them can match the story as told in this Big Picture program.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: The second episode starts on the morning of the 22nd of June 1941 when the Germans launched operation Barbarossa, the code name for the invasion of the Soviet Union. 3 million Axis tools faced more than 4.5 million Red Army troops and were outnumbered two to one in tanks, but superior training and strategies gave the Germans the edge.

programme.title: German Fighters
programme.desc: Hitler acknowledged the existence as the new German air force known as the Luftwaffe on the first of March 1935. The front line fighters of the Luftwaffe during WWII were the Bf-109 and the FW-190. Interviews with pilots who flew these planes and officers who sent them into battle. The film covers German Fighter development and Luftwaffe strategy from the 1930's to the end of World War II.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: Dieppe 1942, the mention of this name and date is enough to recall the sinister memory of an allied raid composed essentially of Canadian troops. On August 19, after 9 hours of fighting, 1,197 Allied soldiers, including 913 Canadians, were killed. 48 French civilians also died... At the height of the fighting, the attackers lost four men per second. The Dieppe raid turned into a massacre!

programme.title: Mother of Normandy
programme.desc: Leslie Caron narrates 'Mother of Normandy,' a documentary highlighting Simone Renaud, wife of the wartime Mayor of Ste. Mere-Eglise. For 44 years, she expressed gratitude to D-Day veterans and families by tending graves, corresponding, and organizing commemorations. Renaud became a cherished figure, leaving an enduring impact on those touched by D-Day's legacy.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: The United Nations planned how best to secure victory and how to arrange the post war world at conference after conference. The Allies fought one war on two fronts. The Axis fought two wars. For both, 1943 would mark the beginning of the end.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Six months have passed with very little action in the Phony War. That is about to end and a new word is added to the vocabulary of warfare - Blitzkrieg.

programme.title: 1945-1953: From World War to Cold War
programme.desc: Learn how, after being brothers in arms during World War II, the Allies would soon become divided in peace. How did a post-war conference in Crimea lead to the Cold War?

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: By 1943-1944, as the Germans are desperately struggling to hold their ground, they are increasingly hindered by the Soviet partisans, which contain many former Red Army soldiers that had been cut off behind enemy lines. The Germans responded with intensive counter-insurgency campaigns and brutal reprisals against the civilian population.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: The basic combat formation of the modern land army is the division. Divisions contain all of the elements needed to wage land combat including infantry, armor, artillery and other supporting arms. Divisions are substantial in size from 10,000 to 20,000 troops, nearly 500 armored vehicles and 2000 other vehicles.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: The U-Boats are ascendant, and their triumphs proclaimed in Germany. But the Allies fight back with new bases in countries bordering the Atlantic Ocean, new anti-submarine techniques and the new escort, or 'jeep', carrier.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Victory on Cherbourg Peninsula - 'Allied troops complete the conquest of the Cherbourg peninsula as reinforcements are flown in by air. 26,000 German prisoners were taken by the allies who either captured or destroyed the greater part of their equipment.'

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The post-war government of Germany is shown. The U.S. in Cologne puts things in order. The Potsdam Conference and Nuremberg War Crimes Trials are shown.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: A film about the Forward Air Controller, whose job it was to spot enemy positions and mark them for attack.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: Our allied units throw a powerful counterattack against the Reds, Infantry tanks, artillery, and air all combine to throw the Reds back to the North, The Navy blasts the enemy with rockets. Captain Zimmerman interviews Chaplain Joseph Murphy of Boston, Massachusetts, and Captain John Rock, former company commander with the 1st Cavalry Division in Korea.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: This episode delves into the darkest chapters of the war: the Holocaust and the ideology of racial superiority that fueled Nazi atrocities. It explores the calculated genocide, forced labor camps, and the systematic destruction of entire communities across Europe. The program highlights the resistance movements that fought back, as well as the moral dilemmas faced by the Allied powers.

programme.title: Action T4: A Doctor Under Nazism
programme.desc: This documentary recounts his story and through the man's story, that of the so-called 'Action T4'. Action T4 consisted of eliminating physical and mental disabilities and those people considered by the Nazi regime to be useless or 'asocial'.

programme.title: The Flying Tigers
programme.desc: The USS President Garfield was heading to China. His true task was to assess the condition of China's air force. His planned three month assignment turned into eight years of warfare. By its end, he would be a major general and the unity created, the Flying Tigers, would be the most famous squadron in the history of aerial warfare.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: While the British army puts the Italian forces to rout, Hitler sends the Afrika Korps led by the general Rommel for help. The Desert fox keeps on winning battles until Montgomery, the British commander, sets up a plan to crush his opponent. After the American landing in North Africa the Axis armies have no choice but to surrender and put an end to the Desert War on May the 13rd of 1943.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Six months after the fall of France, V. Molotov visited Berlin to discuss how the world was to be divided after victory. He was told Britain was defeated. But Britain wasn't beaten. Just alone.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: In April 1945, just weeks before the war's end, Allied troops advancing on the Western Front uncovered and liberated numerous POW, labor, and concentration camps. It was only when the Americans opened camps like Ohrdruf, Buchenwald, and Dachau in Germany that the world truly grasped the scale of the horrors inflicted by the Nazis, revealing atrocities that had remained hidden until then.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler and Wagner
programme.desc: From the moment in 1906 when he heard the first note of Lohengrin at Linz opera house until his death in the burning ruins of Berlin in 1945, Hitler was obsessed by the music and mythology of Richard Wagner. The latest research into the often overlooked relationship with musician August Kubizek, his only boyhood friend, has provided clues which have reveal the overwhelming importance of Wagner.

programme.title: Scorched Earth: The Sinews of War
programme.desc: Documentary looking at the work of those who kept the armies fed and supplied during the Second World War. Using maps, archive footage and interviews with experts Chris Reed and Bob Carruthers, the programme demonstrates the vital place occupied by army logistics in an understanding of the war effort.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With Britain failing to fall, the Blitz drew to a close, the sinking of the German battleship, the Bismarck, lifted the spirits of the British Navy. Hitler's campaign for Russia, Operation Barbarossa, got underway, the course of World War II changed.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: Hitler had expected a decisive victory in Russia, he was thwarted at every turn and while the Luftwaffe bombed Moscow and the Siege of Leningrad began, the Soviet Red Army refused to capitulate. They just watched and waited for the winter snows.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Victory on Cherbourg Peninsula - 'Allied troops complete the conquest of the Cherbourg peninsula as reinforcements are flown in by air. 26,000 German prisoners were taken by the allies who either captured or destroyed the greater part of their equipment.'

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: French civilians and U.S. Army engineers repair and salvage railroad yards, bridges, and trains.

programme.title: Visions of War: The Korean War
programme.desc: Mission of the battleship in Korea. Life aboard, and compartmentational operations.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Speeding behind German lines the men of Troop A, in their armored cars and half-tracks left destruction and fear in their wake. Surprising the German garrison at the town of Epernay, they established an outpost from which they could defend a counter-attack. Outnumbered and outgunned with thirteen rounds of ammunition left, these brave GI's held this vital town until re-enforcements could arrive.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: In 1943, the Axis was on the defensive everywhere. In 1944, The Allies strength would grow in the East, and in the Soviet Union with the opening of the second front.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: Amidst WWII's war-torn skies, Soviet Major Bestuzhev defends the airdrome. A bond forms with comrade Zhenya, but facing overwhelming odds, they must protect their homeland, confronting fears in a narrative of sacrifice, courage, and camaraderie. As the air raid sirens wail, they delve deeper into the turmoil of war, discovering the true essence of duty and the resilience of the human spirit.

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Carey Mulligan's grandfather Denzil Booth, travelled thousands of miles to fight the Japanese in the final months of the war. His university education meant Denzil was fast-tracked to be a junior officer in the Navy. He lost his closest friends on board the first ever ship to be attacked by a Japanese Kamikaze. Carey travels to Japan to understand the culture of the Kamikaze from the other side.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: From September 20 to October 20, 1950 United Nations forces struck hard against the Communist army in Korea. Footage shows the recapture of Seoul, the fall of the North Korean capital city, Pyongyang, an airdrop by the 187th Regimental Airdrop team, and the U.S. Navy battleship Missouri in action.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: A Soviet intelligence officer, long operating as Major Feller, flees the German rear with secret documents detailing enemy fortifications and mines. He links with partisans but they're trapped. Command merges Makeev's saboteurs with Zvonareva's unit: saboteurs seize an improvised German airfield while pilots land behind enemy lines to bring Feller to HQ.

programme.title: Hitler's Propaganda Machine
programme.desc: As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war - to be fought on many battlefields, and for the hearts and minds of the people.

programme.title: Hitler's Eastern Front: Army Group Center
programme.desc: The Wehrmacht organized into 3 army groups for operation. North headed to Stalingrad, South, toward Ukraine, and centre towards the heartland of Russia. Led by General field marshall Fedor Von Bonk, a well known anti nazi, army group centre was the largest and best equipped of all 3 groups. It also contained Gen. Heinz Guderian, perhaps the most renowned commander of the 20th century.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: World War II at sea was marked by the rise of submarines, leading to fierce battles above and below the waves. Crews faced overcrowding and claustrophobia in these confined spaces. This technological evolution paved the way for modern submarines. Developed by Germany, submarines became as crucial to naval warfare as strategic bombers were to the skies, with other countries soon following suit.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: Japan unprovoked invasion had plunged China into war and Europe had been brought to the brink of conflict. In Italy Mussolini introduced fascism to the political landscape and Hitler dismantled democracy. Their expansion threatened neighboring nations.

programme.title: German Jets and Destroyers
programme.desc: Three years after the end of WW1, civil aviation was permitted in Germany and names that were later to spearhead military aircraft production emerged. Names such as Messerschmittt, Heinkel and Yunkers. This documentary discusses the rise of the top German Jets and Destroyers used in battle during WW2.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: Hitler's Architect - The man who designed the Nuremberg Rallies and headed up the slave labour organisation which created the V1 and V2 rockets. Speer was consigned to life imprisonment for his crimes.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: The history of armed conflict is intrinsically tied to the history of civilization and Man's quest for the basic things in life. Over the centuries those weapons ranged from bow and arrows to armor, swords and chain mail. But one technological development left them all behind - the invention of gunpowder. Since then, the advances in weaponry have been both awe-inspiring, and frightening.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: A documented report of Communist atrocities in Korea, with scenes just released depicting the horror and brutality of Communism. Includes interviews with returned prisoners of war who were eye witnesses to some of these atrocities and Major General William Dean and General Mark W. Clark.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Landing Craft - Establishing Beachead. Silent film.

programme.title: David Jason's Secret Service: The Story of Britain's Rich Spy History
programme.desc: Sir David reveals true stories of unbelievable heroism in World War II, in a world of cold-blooded assassins, crack saboteurs, elite commandos, playboy spies, super-villains and femmes fatales.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Fatal Liaison - The Strange Affair of Adolf and Eva
programme.desc: The protracted romance between Adolf Hitler and Eva Braun began in 1929 and ended in 1945 in the bunker under the ruins of the Chancellery. Eva was Hitler's bride for less than 40 hours before she committed suicide.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After 18 months of preparation, the Allied Expeditionary Force launches the largest amphibious landing in history, with 160,000 troops storming the Normandy coast. Facing years of German fortifications, success hinges on overcoming immense challenges during the critical first 24 hours. Victory remains uncertain as the world watches anxiously.

programme.title: Nazi War Criminals
programme.desc: Nazi war criminals are put on trial for their war crimes committed during WWII. This program covers various events from the Lublin Massacre, German atrocities in concentration camps and many others

programme.title: Helicopter Warfare
programme.desc: In the Iraq War, flying in the desert poses unique difficulties - the dust storm that accompanies every landing and take-off - and the lack of places to hide. When a young Royal Navy pilot comes under fire from a tank, he soon finds himself engaged in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: April 16, 1917, for the first time in history, French tanks fight their way through the black sludge of Chemin des Dames. One year before, in October, British tanks tried their luck in Somme. In both cases, the long-awaited miracle did not take place. Yet, a century later, the tanks are still here, monsters of technology that are becoming increasingly efficient.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: Watch as a B-17 Flying Fortress and its crew fights its way over Nazi occupied Europe, battling the enemy's ME-109s and FW-190s. Witness all the fear and excitement of air combat as fighters spit out machine gun fire and brave deadly ground fire.

programme.title: Rough Night in Jericho
programme.desc: The only business in the Wild West town of Jericho that corrupt sheriff Alex Flood (Dean Martin) doesn't control behind the scenes is the stagecoach owned by tough-willed widow Molly Lang (Jean Simmons) and her right-hand man, Hickman (John McIntire). Former marshal Dolan (George Peppard), recently hired by Lang and Hickman as a driver, wants to stay out of the mess, but when he sees Flood's henchman Yarbrough (Slim Pickens) assault Lang, he steps up to fight the corruption.

programme.title: The Thicket
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter and a band of unlikely heroes pursue a brutal killer, they find themselves in a deadly no-man's-land known as the Thicket.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theatre
programme.desc: An immigrant tailor endures cruel jokes and malicious pranks.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theatre
programme.desc: A notorious gunman, fresh out of prison, is framed for a bank robbery.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theatre
programme.desc: Story of a Mexican bandit's love.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theatre
programme.desc: An anthology series based on the novels of Zane Grey.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theatre
programme.desc: A call for justice spawns a lynch mob.

programme.title: Zane Grey Theatre
programme.desc: A cowboy learns that a man has murdered his friend and confiscated the victim's ranch.

programme.title: Best of the Badmen
programme.desc: After the North defeats the South, Union Maj. Jeff Clanton heads to Missouri to provide the Confederacy's Quantrill's Raiders a chance to claim allegiance to the Union, thereby clearing their wanted status. But standing in Clanton's way are the corrupt lawmen Joad and Fowler, who would rather keep the men outlaws to collect the reward on their heads. After Joad and Fowler frame Clanton for murder, he manages to escape, becoming an outlaw himself.

programme.title: Ride, Vaquero
programme.desc: After the Civil War, King Cameron (Howard Keel) moves to Texas, purchases a cattle ranch and settles down with his wife, Cordelia (Ava Gardner). They find themselves at the mercy of Jose Esqueda (Anthony Quinn), a local bandit who has terrorized the town with his adoptive brother, Rio (Robert Taylor). Rio is kidnapped when he tries to mount an attack on the ranch and agrees to work for Cameron so he can be close to Cordelia. Though he's incensed at Rio's betrayal, Jose vows to get him back.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: The story of the notorious outlaw William "Billy the Kid" Bonney. Billy joins a group of outlaws in a South West town when he meets old friend Jim Sherwood, now the town's marshal. He tries to change his ways but when a friend is murdered he falls back into the life of a bandit.

programme.title: Devil's Doorway
programme.desc: Lance Poole (Robert Taylor) is a Native American who left his tribal homelands to fight for the Union in the Civil War. Despite earning the Congressional Medal of Honor for his heroic duties in the line of fire, when he returns home he's still faced with hatred and racism from the white community that neighbors his village. Unable to own property because he's not considered a citizen of the United States, he fights a lawyer's (Louis Calhern) attempts to take over his tribe's hard-earned land.

programme.title: Many Rivers to Cross
programme.desc: Headstrong Mary Stuart Cherne (Eleanor Parker) is in hot pursuit of frontiersman Bushrod Gentry (Robert Taylor), and is determined to make him her husband. Naturally, Bushrod has no desire to leave the happy, wandering life of a trapper. He heads north to escape Mary's nuptial advances. But with hostile Shawnee Indians at every turn, Bushrod and Mary must set aside their differences and work together to survive the wilds of the unfamiliar territory.

programme.title: Westward the Women
programme.desc: There's a deficit of good, honest women in the West, and Roy Whitman (John McIntire) wants to change that. His solution is to bring a caravan of over 100 mail-order brides from Chicago to California. It will be a long, difficult and dangerous journey for the women. So Whitman hires hardened, cynical Buck Wyatt (Robert Taylor) to be their guide across the inhospitable frontier. But as disaster strikes on the trail, Buck just might discover that these women are stronger than he thinks.

programme.title: Return of the Gunfighter
programme.desc: Ben Wyatt (Robert Taylor) is an aging gunfighter who has grown weary of his lifestyle. But when an old friend, Luis (Rodolfo Hoyos Jr.), asks for help defending his land, Ben can't say no. Unfortunately, he arrives too late, finding Luis and his entire family -- except daughter Anisa (Ana Martín) -- murdered. Ben is determined to get revenge against the killers, and in pursuing them reluctantly enlists the aid a younger gunfighter, Lee Sutton (Chad Everett).

programme.title: The Law and Jake Wade
programme.desc: Bandits Clint Hollister (Richard Widmark) and Jake Wade (Robert Taylor) botch a robbery that ends with Clint imprisoned. Despairing, Jake leaves the loot in an abandoned village and quits crime for good. Now working for the law, Jake helps free his old cohort from jail. Clint doesn't want the treasure to go to waste, however, so he forces Jake and his girlfriend, Peggy (Patricia Owens), to lead him to the stash. But to unearth the money, they'll have to get past dangerous Comanche warriors.

programme.title: Saddle the Wind
programme.desc: Steve Sinclair (Robert Taylor) is a former gunfighter and soldier who left his violent ways behind him after the Civil War. Since then, he has settled down as a rancher in a small Western town. But his easygoing life is turned upside down when his unstable little brother, Tony (John Cassavetes), shows up with his bride-to-be, Joan (Julie London). While Steve has given up his gun-toting ways, Tony has not, and his violent tendencies lead to trouble for the entire town.

programme.title: Thunder Over the Plains
programme.desc: It's the late 1860s, and the U.S. government has yet to reclaim Texas as a state. A group of opportunistic and amoral Northerners head south to claim the territory as their own. Though Texas lawman Capt. Porter (Randolph Scott) believes it's his duty to honor the local leaders, he can't ignore the corruption of the Yankee politicians who are giving him orders. When Confederate veteran Ben (Charles McGraw) is unjustly sentenced to death, Porter decides he has had enough of his new bosses.

programme.title: Westbound
programme.desc: A former Union officer, John Hayes (Randolph Scott) now manages a stagecoach company. However, Clay Putnam (Andrew Duggan), a businessman still loyal to the South, is intent on robbing the coaches operated by Hayes, which transport gold to the North from California. Hoping to heist the treasure as a way to revive the Confederacy, Putnam also has a grudge against Hayes, since his wife, Norma (Virginia Mayo), was once involved with the handsome Union soldier.

programme.title: The Cisco Kid
programme.desc: After a woman is wrongfully jailed, Cisco and Pancho plan to trap the real murderer.

programme.title: The Cisco Kid

programme.desc: A veteran cowboy and his nephew save five Chinese girls from prostitution while trekking from Oregon to Wyoming.

programme.title: Future World
programme.desc: A queen lays dying as her son, Prince, travels across a barren wasteland to find a near-mythical medicine to save her life. After evading violent raiders on motorbikes led by the Warlord and his enforcer, Prince meets Ash, a robotic assassin in search of its own soul. When the Druglord captures Prince, he soon finds himself in an epic battle to save the last remnants of humanity.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: Each week Kable, a death-row inmate, battles his fellow prisoners in a violent online game called "Slayers," his every move controlled by a young gamer's remote device. To the players, Kable and the other inmates are just simulated characters. But, to a resistance group that opposes the game's inventor, Kable is a critical component of their plan to end the inventor's form of high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. The only law lies with cops called "judges," who act as judge, jury and executioner, and Dredd (Karl Urban) is one of the city's most feared. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

programme.title: Punisher: War Zone
programme.desc: Frank Castle, aka The Punisher (Ray Stevenson), turns the streets of New York City red as he wages a one-man war against the crime syndicate responsible for the death of his wife and two kids. Aided by his trusted sidekick, Microchip (Wayne Knight), he almost kills Billy Russoti (Dominic West) and leaves him horribly disfigured. Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: To celebrate his 30th birthday, Tyler and his six friends try an escape room challenge. The special mission for escaping a room in one hour starts, and the members immediately notice that the challenge is deadly and difficult.

Mike Enslin is a successful author who enjoys worldwide acclaim debunking supernatural phenomena -- before he checks into the Dolphin Hotel, that is. Ignoring the warnings of the hotel manager, he learns the meaning of real terror when he spends the night in a reputedly haunted room.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray assembles an elite team to assist in the rescue.

programme.title: Escape Plan: The Extractors
programme.desc: Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.

programme.desc: A corrupt emperor (Eric Roberts) forces a soldier (Kevin Stapleton) to fight a single-eyed giant in a gladiatorial arena.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: After the fall of Rome, its last emperor, 12-year-old Romulus Augustus, becomes a prisoner on the island of Capri. With the help of his wise teacher Ambrosinus and his legionnaire Aurelius, he escapes from Capri. He and his men journey to Britannia to find the fabled Dragon Legion, and the beginning of the Arthurian legend is born.

programme.desc: The disbanded Musketeers reunite to defeat a beautiful double agent and the scheming man she is working for.

programme.title: House of 1000 Corpses
programme.desc: An empty fuel tank and a flat tire lead two couples down a terror-riddled road to the House of 1000 Corpses. House of 1000 Corpses is at its core a story of family - a cast of twisted individuals who, with each slash of a throat or stab through the chest, add bodies to their sick human menagerie.

programme.title: The Devil's Rejects
programme.desc: After a raid on the rural home of the psychopathic Firefly family, two members of the clan, Otis (Bill Moseley) and Baby (Sheri Moon Zombie), manage to flee the scene. Heading to a remote desert motel, the killers reunite with Baby's father, Capt. Spaulding (Sid Haig), who is equally demented and intent on maintaining their murder spree. While the trio continues to torment and kill various victims, the vengeful Sheriff Wydell (William Forsythe) slowly closes in on them.

programme.title: 3 From Hell
programme.desc: Crazed killers Baby Firefly, Captain Spaulding and Otis Driftwood unleash bloody mayhem after escaping from prison.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Nearly two decades after being committed to a mental institution for killing his stepfather and older sister, Michael Myers breaks out, intent on returning to the town of Haddonfield, Ill. He arrives in his hometown on Halloween with the indomitable purpose of hunting down his younger sister, Laurie. The only thing standing between Michael and a Halloween night of bloody carnage is psychologist Dr. Samuel Loomis.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion.

programme.title: The Lords of Salem
programme.desc: A radio DJ (Sheri Moon Zombie) in Salem, Mass., is plagued by nightmarish visions of vengeful witches after she plays a record by a mysterious group known only as "The Lords."

programme.desc: Dim-witted Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) and her sex-crazed friend, Brenda (Regina Hall), team up with cute-but-clueless Tom Ryan (Craig Bierko) to save the world from a hostile alien invasion, with hints of War of the Worlds, Saw II, Million Dollar Baby and The Village. Celebrity cameos include Carmen Electra, Shaquille O'Neal, Dr. Phil McGraw, Bill Pullman, Molly Shannon and Michael Madsen.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. Movies that are spoofed in the familiar format include the "Paranormal Activity" franchise, "Mama," "Sinister," "Evil Dead," "Inception," "Black Swan" and "Rise of the Planet of the Apes."

programme.title: Sorry to Bother You
programme.desc: In an alternate reality of present-day Oakland, Calif., telemarketer Cassius Green finds himself in a macabre universe after he discovers a magical key that leads to material glory. As Green's career begins to take off, his friends and co-workers organize a protest against corporate oppression. Cassius soon falls under the spell of Steve Lift, a cocaine-snorting CEO who offers him a salary beyond his wildest dreams.

programme.title: The Crazies
programme.desc: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them.

programme.title: Cell
programme.desc: In a Boston airport, a character named Clay, played by Cusack, observes an electronic signal that causes cellphone users to commit acts of violence. Clay and a train driver, played by Jackson, travel through the city to locate Clay's family while avoiding the violent individuals.

programme.title: The Mist
programme.desc: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice.

programme.title: Cabin Fever
programme.desc: Bert (James DeBello), a college student vacationing with friends in the mountains, mistakenly shoots a local man (Arie Verveen) with a skin infection while hunting in the woods. Panicking, he abandons the scene and leaves the man for dead. When the man stumbles into a reservoir, he infects the water supply, and soon one of Bert's friends becomes infected. The friends struggle to stop the contagious, flesh-eating disease while on the run from a group of ornery backwoods locals out for revenge.

programme.title: Cabin Fever 2: Spring Fever
programme.desc: As students prepare for their high school prom, they have no idea a flesh-eating virus is spreading via a popular brand of water.
